limitations: Checks guard safety in normalized typed IR, not source or LLVM equivalence.
Snapshot fidelity, normalization, canonical integer encoding, immutable tuple views, runtime paired-word contracts and declared parameter layouts remain trusted.
Arithmetic fit claims are checked by the separate Lean integer checker.
Keyword-record tuple views use declared parameter or typed memory-read contracts; general keyword-record joins and transport are not modeled.
Stack tuple copies trust the call ABI: an on-stack tuple has all slots of its exact specialization layout; only complete same-index copies are supported.
scope: promoting-int storage guards of test programs and their imports
